description_en: Ends a hotline service based on the instance ID and agent account name
description_zh: 根据实例ID、坐席账号名称结束热线服务
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs finish-hotline-service --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --account-name username@example.com --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: FinishHotlineService

parameters.help_en: The unique client request ID. Used for idempotence verification. You can use a UUID to generate this ID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The AICCS instance ID.
You can obtain this ID from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The agent account name, which is the mobile phone number or email address specified during account registration. This value is unique within the instance
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称，即账号注册时填写的手机或邮箱。实例内唯一
parameters.name: account_name

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of Success indicates that the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回Success表示请求成功

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。
true：成功。
false：失败
